name: tokentab
description: Shows what Claude Code is spending and stops it at limits you set, built on a Claude Code hooks module: every API call in a ledger from the first prompt, no telemetry setup (Supertab proof of concept).

autoOpen.title: Open the pane at session start
autoOpen.description: Open the TokenTab pane beside the chat when a session starts. Off, /tokentab:status opens it.
